#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>
#include <utility>

using namespace std;

struct Pair {
    long long first;
    long long second;
    static Pair makePair(long long a, long long b) {
        return {a, b};
    }
};

struct Graph {
    static const int REMOVED_BIT = 0;
    int vertexCount;
    int edgeCount;
    vector<int> firstOutbound;
    vector<int> firstInbound;
    struct Edge {
        int id;
    };
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<int> nextInbound;
    vector<int> nextOutbound;
    vector<int> from;
    vector<int> to;
    vector<long long> weight;
    vector<long long> capacity;
    vector<int> reverseEdge;
    vector<int> flags;

    Graph(int vertexCount) : vertexCount(vertexCount) {
        firstOutbound.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        firstInbound.assign(vertexCount, -1);
        from.reserve(vertexCount);
        to.reserve(vertexCount);
        nextOutbound.reserve(vertexCount);
        nextInbound.reserve(vertexCount);
        weight.reserve(vertexCount);
        capacity.reserve(vertexCount);
        reverseEdge.reserve(vertexCount);
        flags.reserve(vertexCount);
        edges.reserve(vertexCount);
    }

    int addEdge(int fromID, int toID, long long w, long long cap, int revEdge) {
        ensureEdgeCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        if (firstOutbound[fromID] != -1) {
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = firstOutbound[fromID];
        } else {
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = -1;
        }
        firstOutbound[fromID] = edgeCount;

        if (firstInbound.size() > toID && firstInbound[toID] != -1) {
            nextInbound[edgeCount] = firstInbound[toID];
        } else {
            nextInbound[edgeCount] = -1;
        }
        if (firstInbound.size() <= toID) {
            firstInbound.resize(toID + 1, -1);
        }
        firstInbound[toID] = edgeCount;

        from.push_back(fromID);
        to.push_back(toID);
        if (cap != 0) {
            if (capacity.size() <= edgeCount) capacity.resize(edgeCount + 1);
            capacity[edgeCount] = cap;
        }
        if (w != 0) {
            if (weight.size() <= edgeCount) weight.resize(edgeCount + 1);
            weight[edgeCount] = w;
        }
        if (revEdge != -1) {
            if (reverseEdge.size() <= edgeCount) reverseEdge.resize(edgeCount + 1);
            reverseEdge[edgeCount] = revEdge;
        }
        edges.push_back({edgeCount});
        return edgeCount++;
    }

    int addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, long long w, long long cap) {
        if (cap == 0) {
            return addEdge(from, to, w, 0, -1);
        } else {
            int lastEdgeCount = edgeCount;
            addEdge(to, from, -w, 0, lastEdgeCount + entriesPerEdge());
            return addEdge(from, to, w, cap, lastEdgeCount);
        }
    }

    int entriesPerEdge() {
        return 1;
    }

    int vertexCountFunc() {
        return vertexCount;
    }

    int firstOutboundFunc(int vertex) {
        int id = firstOutbound[vertex];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }

    int nextOutboundFunc(int id) {
        id = nextOutbound[id];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }

    int source(int id) {
        return from[id];
    }

    int destination(int id) {
        return to[id];
    }

    long long weightFunc(int id) {
        if (weight.size() <= id) return 0;
        return weight[id];
    }

    long long capacityFunc(int id) {
        if (capacity.size() <= id) return 0;
        return capacity[id];
    }

    long long flow(int id) {
        if (reverseEdge.size() <= id) return 0;
        return capacity[reverseEdge[id]];
    }

    void pushFlow(int id, long long flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return;
        if (flow > 0) {
            if (capacity[id] < flow) throw invalid_argument("Not enough capacity");
        } else {
            if (capacity[reverseEdge[id]] < -flow) throw invalid_argument("Not enough capacity");
        }
        capacity[id] -= flow;
        capacity[reverseEdge[id]] += flow;
    }

    bool flag(int id, int bit) {
        return ((flags[id] >> bit) & 1) != 0;
    }

    bool isRemoved(int id) {
        return flag(id, REMOVED_BIT);
    }

    void ensureEdgeCapacity(int size) {
        if (from.size() < size) {
            int newSize = max(size, 2 * (int)from.size());
            from.resize(newSize);
            to.resize(newSize);
            nextOutbound.resize(newSize);
            nextInbound.resize(newSize);
            weight.resize(newSize);
            capacity.resize(newSize);
            reverseEdge.resize(newSize);
            flags.resize(newSize);
        }
    }
};

struct MinCostFlow {
    const Graph& graph;
    int source;
    int destination;
    vector<long long> phi;
    vector<long long> dijkstraResult;
    vector<int> lastEdge;
    struct Heap {
        vector<int> elements;
        vector<int> at;
        int size;
        int maxElement;
        function<int(int, int)> comparator;

        Heap(int capacity, function<int(int, int)> comp, int maxE) : comparator(comp), maxElement(maxE) {
            elements.reserve(capacity);
            at.assign(maxE, -1);
            size = 0;
        }

        bool isEmpty() {
            return size == 0;
        }

        void add(int element) {
            ensureCapacity(size + 1);
            if (elements.size() <= size) elements.push_back(element);
            else elements[size] = element;
            at[element] = size;
            shiftUp(size++);
        }

        void shiftUp(int index) {
            int value = elements[index];
            while (index != 0) {
                int parent = (index - 1) >> 1;
                int parentValue = elements[parent];
                if (comparator(parentValue, value) <= 0) {
                    elements[index] = value;
                    at[value] = index;
                    return;
                }
                elements[index] = parentValue;
                at[parentValue] = index;
                index = parent;
            }
            elements[0] = value;
            at[value] = 0;
        }

        void shiftDown(int index) {
            while (true) {
                int child = (index << 1) + 1;
                if (child >= size) break;
                if (child + 1 < size && comparator(elements[child], elements[child + 1]) > 0) {
                    child++;
                }
                if (comparator(elements[index], elements[child]) <= 0) break;
                swap(index, child);
                index = child;
            }
        }

        void swap(int first, int second) {
            int temp = elements[first];
            elements[first] = elements[second];
            elements[second] = temp;
            at[elements[first]] = first;
            at[elements[second]] = second;
        }

        int getIndex(int element) {
            return at[element];
        }

        void ensureCapacity(int size) {
            if (elements.size() < size) {
                int newCap = max((int)elements.size() * 2, size);
                elements.resize(newCap);
            }
        }

        int poll() {
            if (isEmpty()) throw out_of_range("Heap is empty");
            int result = elements[0];
            at[result] = -1;
            if (size == 1) {
                size = 0;
                return result;
            }
            elements[0] = elements[--size];
            at[elements[0]] = 0;
            shiftDown(0);
            return result;
        }
    };

    MinCostFlow(const Graph& g, int s, int d, bool hasNegativeEdges) : graph(g), source(s), destination(d) {
        int vCount = g.vertexCountFunc();
        phi.resize(vCount, 0);
        if (hasNegativeEdges) {
            fordBellman();
        }
        dijkstraResult.resize(vCount, LLONG_MAX);
        lastEdge.resize(vCount, -1);
        if (g.isSparse()) {
            comparator = [](int a, int b) { return (int)(dijkstraResult[a] - dijkstraResult[b]); };
            heap = new Heap(vCount, comparator, vCount);
            visited = nullptr;
        } else {
            heap = nullptr;
            visited.resize(vCount, 0);
        }
    }

    ~MinCostFlow() {
        delete heap;
    }

    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[source] = 0;
        vector<bool> inQueue(phi.size(), false);
        vector<int> queue(phi.size() + 1);
        int head = 0, end = 1;
        queue[0] = source;
        inQueue[source] = true;
        int maxSteps = 2 * (int)phi.size() * (int)phi.size();
        int stepCount = 0;
        while (head != end) {
            int vertex = queue[head++];
            if (head == (int)queue.size()) head = 0;
            inQueue[vertex] = false;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutboundFunc(vertex);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                long long total = phi[vertex] + graph.weightFunc(edgeID);
                int dest = graph.destination(edgeID);
                if (graph.capacityFunc(edgeID) != 0 && phi[dest] > total) {
                    phi[dest] = total;
                    if (!inQueue[dest]) {
                        queue[end++] = dest;
                        inQueue[dest] = true;
                        if (end == (int)queue.size()) end = 0;
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutboundFunc(edgeID);
            }
            if (++stepCount > maxSteps) throw invalid_argument("Graph contains negative cycle");
        }
    }

    Pair minCostMaxFlow() {
        return minCostMaxFlow(LLONG_MAX);
    }

    Pair minCostMaxFlow(long long maxFlow) {
        long long cost = 0;
        long long flow = 0;
        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            if (graph.isSparse()) {
                dijkstraAlgorithm();
            } else {
                dijkstraAlgorithmFull();
            }
            if (lastEdge[destination] == -1) {
                return Pair::makePair(cost, flow);
            }
            for (size_t i = 0; i < dijkstraResult.size(); ++i) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != LLONG_MAX) {
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
                }
            }
            int vertex = destination;
            long long currentFlow = maxFlow;
            long long currentCost = 0;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                currentFlow = min(currentFlow, graph.capacity(edgeID));
                currentCost += graph.weightFunc(edgeID);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
            maxFlow -= currentFlow;
            cost += currentCost * currentFlow;
            flow += currentFlow;
            vertex = destination;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                graph.pushFlow(edgeID, currentFlow);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
        }
        return Pair::makePair(cost, flow);
    }

private:
    function<int(int, int)> comparator;
    Heap* heap;
    vector<int>* visited;

    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        heap->add(source);
        while (!heap->isEmpty()) {
            int current = heap->poll();
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutboundFunc(current);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacityFunc(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    long long total = graph.weightFunc(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[current] + dijkstraResult[current];
                    if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                        dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                        if (heap->getIndex(next) == -1) {
                            heap->add(next);
                        } else {
                            heap->shiftUp(heap->getIndex(next));
                        }
                        lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutboundFunc(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull() {
        static int visitIndex = 0;
        static vector<int> visitedGlobal;
        if (visitedGlobal.size() == 0) visitedGlobal.resize(dijkstraResult.size(), 0);
        visitIndex++;
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[destination] = LLONG_MAX;
        int vCount = (int)dijkstraResult.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < vCount; ++i) {
            if (visitedGlobal[i] != visitIndex && dijkstraResult[i] < LLONG_MAX) {
                // do nothing
            }
        }
        // Dijkstra's algorithm without heap
        for (int i = 0; i < vCount; ++i) {
            int index = -1;
            long long length = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int j = 0; j < vCount; ++j) {
                if (visitedGlobal[j] != visitIndex && dijkstraResult[j] < length) {
                    length = dijkstraResult[j];
                    index = j;
                }
            }
            if (index == -1) break;
            visitedGlobal[index] = visitIndex;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutboundFunc(index);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacityFunc(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    if (visitedGlobal[next] != visitIndex) {
                        long long total = graph.weightFunc(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[index] + length;
                        if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                            dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                            lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                        }
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutboundFunc(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> cnt(26, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        cnt[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }
    Graph g(n + 100);
    int source = n + 100 - 2;
    int target = source + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i * 2 < n; ++i) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i, target, 0, 2);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        g.addFlowWeightedEdge(source, i + n, 0, cnt[i]);
        for (int j = 0; j * 2 < n; ++j) {
            if (s[j] == s[n - j - 1]) {
                int w = 0;
                if (s[j] - 'a' == i) w = -max(a[j], a[n - j - 1]);
                g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
            } else {
                int w = 0;
                if (s[j] - 'a' == i) w -= a[j];
                if (s[n - j - 1] - 'a' == i) w -= a[n - j - 1];
                g.addFlowWeightedEdge(i + n, j, w, 1);
            }
        }
    }
    MinCostFlow mcmf(g, source, target, true);
    auto result = mcmf.minCostMaxFlow();
    cout << -result.first << "\n";
    return 0;
}
